geometry.body: Light gray elongated shell, near-flat recessed rounded-rectangle top panel; nose corners clipped into faceted shoulders and a narrow dark horizontal brow.
geometry.arms: Thin straight pale-gray arms. Front arms meet forward body shoulders; rear folding roots are farther aft and lower. Distinct silver motor cylinders.
geometry.camera: Small black single-lens camera hangs close under nose; narrow round side pivot drums.
geometry.landingGear: Long thin blade-shaped feet under front motors; short nib feet at rear motors.
geometry.other: Black two-blade props with orange tips. This shell is flatter and more angular than ATOM 3.
geometry.basis: Direct visual inspection of downloaded official product imagery; geometry is qualitative, not measured CAD.

geometry.body: Bulbous wide forehead and sculpted convex roof; deep nose cavity. Top narrows toward rear battery/button area. Thin dark wraparound brow.
geometry.arms: Pale-gray rectangular arms. Rear arms attach to conspicuous circular folding hinges low on the belly sides.
geometry.camera: Large rounded-square black camera pod and thick black U-shaped yoke fill the deep nose opening; much more substantial than ATOM 2 camera.
geometry.landingGear: Long flat front motor legs and short rear feet; the four legs must not share one length.
geometry.other: Orange-tipped two-blade props. Image also contains the controller; ignore controller in aircraft mesh.
geometry.basis: Direct visual inspection of downloaded official product imagery; geometry is qualitative, not measured CAD.

geometry.body: Glossy white shallow saucer/hump center with black pill-shaped nose opening. Shell blends smoothly into the fixed X arms.
geometry.arms: Integrated curved tubular fixed arms without folding hinges; silver motor cylinders with tall white spinner domes.
geometry.camera: Camera hangs far below fuselage on a visible vibration-isolation plate with four rubber dampers and a vertical yaw spindle. White/silver block camera and round side gimbal motors.
geometry.landingGear: Two large white trapezoid hoops/skids along the sides; sloped front/rear uprights. No four motor-foot stance.
geometry.other: This is a Phantom-like fixed-airframe silhouette. Photo includes controller/case; ignore those.
geometry.basis: Direct visual inspection of downloaded official product imagery; geometry is qualitative, not measured CAD.

geometry.body: Very thick orange stepped shell. Wide rounded front canopy, narrower rear spine in top view. Deep belly/battery housing with diagonal side ventilation slots.
geometry.arms: Thick black rectangular arms have different root heights: forward arm root high beneath orange shoulder, aft root low near belly rear. Folded reference exposes this clearly. Heavy cylindrical black motors with red trim.
geometry.camera: Silver rounded-square 6K camera with very large inset black circular lens, round side pivot drums and black vertical mount; nose has two large circular obstacle eyes in a dark connected face mask.
geometry.landingGear: Long tapered front motor legs and shorter rear-motor feet; white rectangular lamps on motor housings.
geometry.other: Photos are folded, so use them for shell and joint placement, not deployed span. Two small side obstacle cameras and two top circles are visible.
geometry.basis: Direct visual inspection of downloaded official product imagery; geometry is qualitative, not measured CAD.

geometry.body: Very small slim, low, rounded boat-shaped shell; broad shallow nose tapers into narrow rear battery spine. Dark or contrasting continuous brow joins two small circular obstacle eyes.
geometry.arms: Slim black rounded-rectangle arms; forward pair attaches high at shoulders, rear pair lower with round side hinge. Motors are relatively small.
geometry.camera: Small black horizontally cylindrical camera/gimbal assembly with a circular red-ringed lens and round side motor drums.
geometry.landingGear: Long skinny straight front feet; very short rear motor feet.
geometry.other: Gray unfolded and orange folded references are color variants, not different basic geometries.
geometry.basis: Direct visual inspection of downloaded official product imagery; geometry is qualitative, not measured CAD.

geometry.body: Elongated orange shell with a visibly raised rear battery hump and seam behind sloped nose hood; fuller/deeper than Nano. Two small round obstacle eyes joined by dark brow.
geometry.arms: Wide flat rectangular carbon-pattern arms with clear straight upper edges; front roots at shoulder height, rear circular hinges lower. Larger deployed span relative to center body than Nano.
geometry.camera: Large silver block 6K camera under nose, circular black/red lens face and gray cylindrical side pivots; not the Nano black barrel.
geometry.landingGear: Long thin straight black front motor legs; short rear feet. A rectangular lamp is integrated in each front motor base.
geometry.other: Image depicts Lite+ 6K payload. Plain Lite differs in camera/gimbal; do not copy a 6K label across variants.
geometry.basis: Direct visual inspection of downloaded official product imagery; geometry is qualitative, not measured CAD.

geometry.body: Gray angular forehead with two small forward round obstacle eyes and a raised center battery spine.
geometry.arms: Long dark rectangular arms. Front roots high and rear roots lower.
geometry.camera: 640T aircraft in foreground has two round lens apertures side by side in a rounded black rectangular pod with gray rim; 6K aircraft behind has a single-lens camera.
geometry.landingGear: Long skinny front legs, much shorter rear motor feet.
geometry.other: This official banner was initially downloaded as evo-max-home.png; corrected filename is evo-lite-enterprise.png. Do not use this as EVO Max reference.
geometry.basis: Direct visual inspection of downloaded official product imagery; geometry is qualitative, not measured CAD.

geometry.body: Tall gray slab-like central fuselage and broad flatter canopy; angular stepped sidewalls and deep open U-shaped mouth below the brow. Upper sensor circles and a small raised roof puck are visible.
geometry.arms: Substantial long rectangular gray beams. Front shoulders high and rear roots distinctly lower at aft base; this is a two-level structure, not a single flat X.
geometry.camera: Large rounded-rectangle multichannel payload on long central gimbal stem in open nose cavity; four asymmetric apertures in a 2x2 arrangement: wide rectangular upper-left window, yellow round upper-right, large lower-left round lens, small lower-right round lens. Side pitch motor is a large round disk.
geometry.landingGear: Long outward-sloping gray front motor legs; short rear motor feet. Large black motor cans with thin orange rings and integrated lamps.
geometry.other: Current product page and images represent Max 4T/V2 family. 4N payload needs its own lens arrangement; this image does not verify 4N.
geometry.basis: Direct visual inspection of downloaded official product imagery; geometry is qualitative, not measured CAD.

unavailable.reason: Official URLs extracted from page links; every image download returned HTTP 403. No image viewed; no new geometric claims made.
